rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=5, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=6, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=480, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (DATA-COVERAGE lever): train_n 200 -> 480 (~35% -> ~83% of the 579-slice train pool). BASE = iter-1 BEST config (vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False; NOT the regressed iter-2/3/4). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS, all hr=0, ALL BELOW the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor, baseline_PSNR 34.08): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 PSNR 32.40 RMSE 1.199e-3 (N_k=16, lam=0.0023, elapsed 1295.7s) <- BEST; iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity UP -> REGRESSED -0.0133, 1351.7s); iter-3 SSIM 0.768197 PSNR 32.07 (vn_lambda_init 0.0023->0.05 DC UP -> REGRESSED -0.0238, 1159.6s); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 PSNR 23.80 RMSE 3.228e-3 (vn_normalize_filters F->T -> REGRESSED -0.0346, 1339.8s). LIMITER / FAILURE MODE: every STRUCTURAL knob tried (capacity^, DC-weight^, filter-constraint) made it WORSE; loss flat by ep3 so it is NOT under-training; the learned VN regulariser term Sum_i K_i^T rho'_i(K_i u) collapses to a BLUNT SMOOTHER that drags the recon monotonically below its own FBP init. iter-4's terminal falsifier ('SSIM<=0.84 with the regulariser constrained -> structurally FBP-bounded') FIRED. BUT one axis is UNTESTED and shared by ALL 4 iters: every iter trained on the SAME 200/579 (35%) stratified subset. MECHANISM CONFIRMED (this turn): hammernik_vn build_dataset calls load_val_split(split='train', n=train_n) = a FIXED stratified subset chosen ONCE (round-robin across ps-groups, sel=sorted(picks)), then the train loop reshuffles ONLY that subset via torch.randperm(train_n) per epoch -- it does NOT use RotatingSubsetDataset. So train_n=200 = the net only ever sees 35% of the 579-slice train pool -> train_n IS a LIVE data-coverage lever (same mechanism as uswin train_n 200->480 hr 0.3532->0.3829 and itnet_v3 200->400 hr 0.3123->0.3288). This is the strongest untried axis AND the cleanest single-knob test of whether the regulariser degradation is data-coverage-starved (200 slices too few for the 16-filter bank to learn an edge-preserving rather than smoothing regulariser) vs a true structural ceiling. HYPOTHESIS: if the degradation is data-starved, train_n 200->480 lifts val_ssim above the iter-1 0.80528 and toward/over the ~0.84 FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER (terminal): if val_ssim stays <=0.81 (still <FBP, hr=0) even at 2.4x the training data, hammernik_vn is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on rebinned 2304-view Mayo LDCT with the data-coverage lever EXHAUSTED -> file the negative result and drive remaining iters to document the ceiling. GRAD-STEP PARITY (isolate DATA COVERAGE from extra optimization): iter-1 was max_train_s=1000-bound and ran ~7 epochs at 200 slices = ~1400 grad-slices. At train_n=480, max_train_s=1000 (kept) caps ~2.9 epochs (480x2.9 ~= 1392 grad-slices) -> near-identical optimization budget, so the comparison isolates COVERAGE not extra steps. BUDGET (HARD 20-min train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): iter-1 trained ~7 ep / 1000s at 200 slices => ~143 s/ep => ~0.715 s/slice/ep; at 480 slices ~343 s/ep, so max_train_s=1000 trips at ~2.9 ep (epochs=6 is just an upper bound the wall trips first). Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~160 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1160s, under the 1800s SLURM kill, ~640s margin. MEMORY-SAFE: identical per-step footprint to iter-1 (batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true keep N_k=16 within the 16 GB RTX5000; cf. hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).
